P.name: Dauntless Instinct
P.title: Template:Data K'Sante/Dauntless Instinct
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Dauntless Instinct|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = K'Sante
|skill        = I
|icon         = Dauntless Instinct.png
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''K'Sante's''' {{tip|abilities}} mark enemies hit for 4 seconds. His {{tip|basic attack|basic attacks}} against marked enemies are empowered to consume the mark, dealing {{as|12|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{pplevel|1 to 2|key=%}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}. The damage based on the target's health ratio deals a minimum of {{pplevel|10 + 5*x}} against {{tip|minion|minions}} and is capped at {{pplevel|15 + 5*x}} against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
|description3 = {{sbc|{{ai|All Out|K'Sante|All Out}} Bonus:}} '''K'Sante's''' basic attacks and {{tip|ability damage}}, as well as ''Dauntless Instinct's'' mark consumption, are empowered to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{as|1% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|(+ 1% per 100 '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}.
|effect radius= 
|width        = 
|speed        = 
|angle        = 
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = physical
|spellshield  = special
|spelleffects = special
|projectile   = 
|parry        = special
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
* The mark deals {{tip|proc damage}} in sequence after the basic attack.
** This causes effects like {{ri|Bone Plating}} to be triggered an extra time.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the mark's application, but not the mark's consumption from an attack.
* The empowered attack can be {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}}, and missed while {{tip|blind|blinded}} but the mark will not be consumed.
* Starting the empowered attack while the mark is about to time out will not extend the mark duration, but still complete the attack and apply the bonus damage.
* All Out's bonus damage on abilities only applies to the first target hit when damaging multiple enemies (including minions and monsters).{{bug}}
** For most of '''K'Sante's''' spells and item effects, in the case of multiple targets being stuck on the same game tick, this refers to the closest target. For non-missile {{ai|Ntofo Strikes|K'Sante}}, it instead depends on the order in which the target units were spawned into the match.{{bug}}
* All Out's bonus damage amps the benefiting damage instance without applying an extra damage instance.
** This causes effects like {{ri|Bone Plating}} to not be triggered an extra time.
|flavorsound  = 
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurbicon    = Dauntless Instinct.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|K'Sante}} {{tip|abilities}} mark enemies hit for a short time. His {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} consume the mark to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
|blurb4       = {{sbc|{{ai|All Out|K'Sante|All Out}} Bonus:}} K'Sante's basic attacks and abilities are empowered to deal {{as|'''additional bonus''' physical damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}, increased based on '''K'Sante's''' '''bonus''' {{as|armor}} and {{as|magic resist}}.
}}
